(২) গ্রীন চ্যানেল অতিক্রমকারী সর্বোচ্চ ৫% (শতকরা পাঁচ ভাগ) যাত্রীর ব্যাগেজ দৈবচয়নের ভিত্তিতে শুল্ক (Customs) কর্মকর্তা কর্তৃক স্ক্যানিং ও পরীক্ষা করা যাইবে।
(৩) উপ-বিধি (১) ও (২) এ যাহা কিছুই থাকুক না কেন, কোন শুল্ক (Customs) কর্মকর্তা, যুক্তিসংগত সন্দেহবশত গ্রীন চ্যানেল অতিক্রমকারী যে কোন যাত্রীর ব্যাগেজ স্ক্যানিং ও পরীক্ষা করিতে পারিবেন।

Green Channel: Passengers who are not carrying dutiable goods may use the Green Channel at the airport if it is available.
A portion of passengers passing through the Green Channel may be subject to baggage scanning and examination by customs officers on a random basis.
Customs officers have the authority to scan and examine the baggage of any passenger using the Green Channel if they have a reasonable suspicion.
Red Channel: The Red Channel is the designated passage for passengers carrying dutiable goods, as established by the context of airport clearance procedures.
Appropriate Officer of Customs: A customs officer is authorized to conduct random baggage checks on up to a specified percentage of passengers using the Green Channel.
A customs officer retains the discretionary power to perform baggage scanning and inspection on any passenger, regardless of the random selection process, if there is a reasonable suspicion.

(৩) ভুলবশতঃ অথবা অন্য কোন অনিবার্য কারণে উপ-বিধি (১) ও উপ-বিধি (২) এর বিধান মোতাবেক কোন যাত্রী কর্তৃক ঘোষণা প্রদান করা সম্ভব না হইলে আগমনের ৩ (তিন) দিনের মধ্যে সংশ্লিষ্ট সহকারী কমিশনার অব কাস্টমস এর (Assistant Commissioner of Customs) নিম্নে নহেন এমন শুল্ক (Customs) কর্মকর্তার নিকট তফসিল-১ এ বর্ণিত ফরম পূরণ করিয়া তিনি ব্যাগেজ ঘোষণা প্রদান করিতে পারিবেন।
(৪) একজন যাত্রী ১ (এক) পঞ্জিকা বৎসরে মাত্র ১ (এক) বার unaccompanied baggage আনিতে পারিবেন।

Baggage Declaration: All passengers arriving from abroad are required to submit a baggage declaration to the customs authorities using the prescribed form.
For unaccompanied baggage, the passenger must submit a declaration using the prescribed form before leaving the customs hall or designated customs area.

If a passenger fails to declare baggage due to unavoidable reasons, they may submit the required declaration to an officer not below the rank of Assistant Commissioner of Customs within a specified period from their arrival.
Assistant Commissioner of Customs: In cases where a passenger fails to declare baggage upon arrival due to unavoidable circumstances, they may file a delayed declaration with an officer holding the rank of Assistant Commissioner of Customs or higher.
Baggage: Passengers are restricted to importing unaccompanied baggage only once per calendar year.

Passenger Baggage Allowance: The baggage of a Bangladeshi citizen who passes away while abroad is exempt from the payment of all customs duties and taxes.

Passenger Baggage: When a passenger imports goods that are not listed in the specified schedules, such items are treated as commercial imports.
The import of such goods is permitted subject to the submission of clearance from the Chief Controller of Imports and Exports.
Clearance is subject to the completion of adjudication proceedings and the payment of all applicable customs duties, taxes, fines, and penalties.
Adjudication of Customs Cases: Adjudication is required to determine and assess the applicable duties, taxes, and penalties for goods imported by passengers that fall outside the permitted baggage schedules.
Chief Controller of Imports and Exports: The Chief Controller of Imports and Exports acts as the regulatory authority whose clearance must be presented when a passenger attempts to clear commercial-quantity baggage that is not covered by standard passenger baggage schedules.
